title: US removes all bombers from RAF Fairford base
summary_cn: 美国已从英国皇家空军费尔福德基地撤出所有轰炸机，此前该基地附近发生了一起反恐警察正在调查的事件。美方未说明撤出原因，但白宫消息人士未否认此举是对9月27日事件的回应。该事件中六名男子因涉嫌恐怖主义罪行被捕后获保释，英国首相曾表示有强烈迹象表明伊朗参与其中，但德黑兰坚决否认。
paragraphs_en: A Rockwell B1 Lancer heavy bomber takes off to depart for home at RAF Fairford on Sunday
The US has withdrawn all of its bombers from RAF Fairford, the British military base at the centre of an incident being investigated by counter terror police.
A statement from a US department official confirmed on Sunday it had removed all of its bombers from the base back to their home stations in America.
The US did not give a reason for the withdrawal, but it follows a major incident on 27 September when police were alerted to three "suspicious vehicles" near the airbase in Gloucestershire.

Five men were initially arrested on suspicion of terror offences near the base and subsequently released on police bail. A sixth man, a UK-Iranian national, was also later arrested and released on bail.
Whitehall sources have not disputed the decision from Washington was in response to the incident at RAF Fairford.
The BBC has also been told it was a military rather than a political decision - taken at an operational level - and communicated from the US military to its British counterparts.
The UK's Ministry of Defence has not commented.

Days after the incident, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said there were "strong indications" that Iran had played a part in the incident but did not provide further details. Tehran has strongly denied any involvement.

Initially, five men aged between 23 and 25 were arrested in the early hours of the morning after vehicles were reported to be travelling towards the base operated by the US Air Force (USAF). All five were UK nationals from London.

They were arrested on suspicion of explosives offences and later on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act, before being released on bail in what police called an "investigative decision" that was "grounded in experience and strategy".
The sixth man, aged 25, was arrested in London on Thursday on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts. Counter terror police confirmed on Saturday he had also been released on bail.
RAF Fairford has been used as a forward operating location by the US Air Force (USAF) for decades.
In recent months, US bombers have taken off from the base for the Middle East, after the UK approved a US request to use it for defensive strikes on Iran.
In July, Iran said "any base used for aggression against Iranian territory constitutes a legitimate target for our forces".
Days after the incident, and before the arrest of the sixth man, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Fox News that it "clearly involve[d] the hands of a foreign actor".
Rubio did not provide further details - saying at the time he was limited on what he could say on air.
US President Donald Trump separately said he was "surprised" the five men had been released on bail.
"We know everything about them, we would not have released them," he said, adding that the UK had worked with the US "very closely" on this.
paragraphs_cn: 周日，一架罗克韦尔B1“枪骑兵”重型轰炸机起飞，从英国皇家空军费尔福德基地（RAF Fairford）返回美国。
美国已从英国皇家空军费尔福德基地撤出所有轰炸机。该基地是一起正由反恐警察调查的事件中心。
美国国防部一名官员周日发表声明，确认已将全部轰炸机从该基地撤回美国本土驻地。
美方未说明撤出原因，但此前9月27日发生了一起重大事件，警方接到警报称格洛斯特郡（Gloucestershire）空军基地附近出现三辆“可疑车辆”。
最初有5名男子因涉嫌恐怖犯罪在基地附近被捕，随后获警方保释。之后，第6名男子——一名英国-伊朗籍人士——也被逮捕并获保释。
白厅消息人士并未否认华盛顿的决定是对费尔福德基地事件的回应。
英国广播公司（BBC）还获悉，这是军事而非政治决定——在作战层面作出——并由美军向英方对口部门传达。
事件发生数日后，首相安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）表示有“强烈迹象”表明伊朗参与了该事件，但未提供更多细节。德黑兰方面强烈否认任何 involvement。
最初，在接到车辆驶向美国空军（USAF）运营的基地的报告后，5名年龄在23至25岁之间的男子于凌晨被捕。5人均为来自伦敦的英国公民。
他们因涉嫌爆炸物犯罪被捕，后因涉嫌准备恐怖行为被捕，随后获保释。警方称这是“基于经验和策略的调查决定”。
第6名男子25岁，于周四在伦敦因涉嫌准备恐怖行为被捕。反恐警察周六确认他也已获保释。
英国皇家空军费尔福德基地数十年来一直被美国空军（USAF）用作前沿作战地点。
近几个月来，在英国批准美国使用该基地对伊朗进行防御性打击的请求后，美国轰炸机从该基地起飞前往中东。
7月，伊朗表示“任何被用于侵略伊朗领土的基地都是我们部队的合法目标”。
事件发生数日后、第6名男子被捕前，美国国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥（Marco Rubio）在福克斯新闻（Fox News）上表示，此事“明显涉及外国行为者的手”。
鲁比奥未提供更多细节——称当时他在电视上能说的有限。
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）另行表示，他对5名男子获保释感到“惊讶”。
“我们对他们了如指掌，我们不会释放他们，”他说，并补充称英国在此事上与美国“非常密切”合作。
